minutes.headline: Select Board held a goals workshop and moved a reserve transfer for the library director's contract.
minutes.summary: After public comment objecting to a PAC policy restricting volunteer videographers, the board took up a library director salary reserve transfer and signed warrants. what_happened.line: The board took up a reserve fund transfer from the salary reserve line to the library for the library director's new contract; the vote result was not audible.
The board decided economic development will not be a board goal; the town manager will draft a mission statement and the board will revisit it.
The board agreed the town assets plan will be an inventory, assessment, cost and policy goal, with a five-buildings action goal kept separate.
The board agreed to reach out to the School Committee and the new superintendent for a joint meeting on school budget relations.
Public comment objected to a PAC policy restricting volunteer videographers from public comment, citing First Amendment rights and lack of agenda notice.

why_it_matters: The goals set here steer what the town manager and board work on in the coming year, including how town buildings are maintained and paid for, which reaches the town budget, mostly taxes.
A joint meeting with the School Committee could shape how school budgets are coordinated with the town's, and the recording of public meetings was also questioned in public comment.
